Bold friendly geometric sans lettering, both O shapes have a tiny eye glint to suggest an expressive typographic mascot, no animal or human body. Crisp flat vector-like design, premium university AI app branding. Large safe margins, all glyphs must be complete and legible, no cropping. No UNIV text in this small app icon. No other words, no photorealism, no bevel, no glow, no drop shadow, no decorative frame. Deliver just a single icon filling a square canvas.
